posts.cooked:
Okay, yeah I was thinking the promo cards from Villains, this makes sense.

I guess it would also mean we aren't likely to have any villain promos in the Villains of the multiverse 7.

 

La Capitan, Plague Rat, Citizens Anvil and Hammer and Miss Information are getting decks in vengeance, and while it is true that the villains that got reworked had room for it, they were also very important parts of the story line, with Cosmitron being the link to all the other Omnitrons, Baron Blade being the main Villain character of the game, and Spite + Gloomy being the reason the Dark Watch form, and they are clearly a big deal.

 

Apostate totally fits that bill, as does Akash'bhuta.

There's also a possibility one of the WCos villains was designed with a promo version already in mind.  I could easily see Deadline or Wager Master's decks going in very different directions.

Actaully Wager Master is a pretty good bet.

 

What I'd really like to see is Dreamer's deck turned into a Dark Visionary villain deck.  One where Venessa grows a few years older but has been taken over by Visionary's dark passenger, and has much better control over her projections.  One where you aren't trying to keep her alive.
